race.comment: PIERRO LAD (2) just missed the placings last time out but prior to that had strung three wins together on the bounce. Gets the services of Lloyd on board from the low draw and should give backers a sight. Import GRAFTON STREET (5) has hit the frame in both local outings to date and will be ready for the step-up in trip now. Has to be included in calculations. MY CHARM (6) will be rock-hard fit now fourth-up from the break and is more than capable enough on her day. Top-three candidate on best figures. SUPREME SOVEREIGN (9) has placed around this circuit and is usually thereabouts. One for the exotics players.
